title: InterpretRequest
description: Payload sent from the Chrome Extension to the Companion Service to parse user speech into proposed field updates.

requestId.description: Unique identifier for tracing this interpretation round.

sessionContext.description: Contextual metadata binding the request to an active tab and form snapshot.

sessionId.description: Ephemeral session identifier generated when Piko is activated on a page.

formInstanceId.description: Identifier representing the current immutable DOM snapshot of the form.

origin.description: Security origin of the web page where the form resides (e.g., https://example.com).

pageTitle.description: Sanitized document title of the target web page.

transcript.description: User spoken answer transcribed by whisper.cpp or typed user text.

fields.description: Array of eligible visible form fields currently discovered on the webpage.

knownFacts.description: Previously confirmed user facts stored in ephemeral session memory.

factValue.description: Value confirmed by the user in an earlier step of this session.

sourceFieldId.description: Opaque field ID from which this fact originated, if applicable.
